eng.greet: Welcome to the studio. I'm your engineer. Want to cut a track?
eng.pickbeat: Pick a beat from the panel, or load your own. Hit record when you're ready, and I'll count you in.
eng.stepin: Step into the booth and get close to the mic. Headphones on.
eng.good: That's a clean take. Levels look good. Want to run it back?
eng.clip: You were clipping on that one. Back off the mic a little and try again.
eng.quiet: That was a bit quiet. Move closer to the mic, or give me more volume.
eng.silent: I didn't catch anything. Check that your mic is allowed in the browser.
eng.save: Download your take before you leave. We don't keep anything here.

dj.greet: What's good, welcome to the Hood Rich Club. I've got the decks tonight.
dj.ask: Tap a track to vote for what plays next.
dj.vote: Got your vote. I'll see if the room agrees.
dj.next: Alright, switching it up. Here's the next one.
dj.idle: Request something. I take votes all night.

door.fawn: Evening, Fawn. Welcome in. Enjoy the night.
door.buck: Buck. Good to see you. Go on in.
door.stag: Stag. The club is yours tonight. Go on in.
door.royalstag: Royal Stag. Right this way. The whole club is yours.
door.founder: Founder. You built this place. Welcome home.
door.info: Members only. Ten million Stag, or a Founder N F T. You are on the list. Enjoy.
door.guest: Welcome in. First time? Have a look around, and enjoy the night.

patrol.enjoy: Enjoy your night. I am watching the floor.
patrol.safe: Nobody gets in here without making the list. You are safe.

bar.greet: Evening. What can I get you? Everything's on the house tonight.
bar.menu: Take a look at the menu. All free right now, so don't be shy.
bar.hi: Welcome in. Pull up a stool.

patron.hi: Best seat in the house, friend.
patron.tip: Try the pink one. Trust me.

dealer.hi: Welcome to the card room. Pull up a seat and I'll deal you in.
dealer.rules: Texas Hold'em, play chips only. You get a free top-up every day if you run low. Sit down and I'll deal.
